question:
Solve the following:

(a + b + c)(ab + bc + ca) – abc = ?
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित को हल कीजिये:

(a + b + c)(ab + bc + ca) – abc = ?
solution:
(a + b + c)(ab + bc + ca) – abc

a2b + abc + a2c + ab2 + b2c + abc + abc + bc2 + c2a – abc

= a2b + a2c + b2c + bc2 + ab2 + c2a + 2abc

= a2(b + c) + bc(b + c) + a(b2 +c2 + 2bc)

= a2(b + c) + bc(b + c) + a(b + c)2

= (b + c) (a2 + bc + ab + ac)

= (b + c) (a2 + ab + bc + ac)

= (b + c) {a(a + b) + c(a + b)}

= (b + c) {(a + b)(a + c)}

= (a + b)(b + c)(a + c)

Alternate Solution:

= (a + b + c)(ab + bc + ca) – abc = ?

Put a = b = c = 1, the

(1 + 1 + 1) (1 + 1 + 1) – 1

3 × 3 – 1

8

With the help of option (4)

(a + b)(b + c)(c + a)

2 × 2 × 2

8 (satisfied)

question: The sides of a triangular park are in the ratio of 12 : 17 : 25 and its perimeter is 1080 m. The area (in hectares) of the park is ______.
question_hi: एक त्रिभुजाकार बाग़ की भुजाएँ 12 : 17 : 25 के अनुपात में हैं और इसका परिमाप 1080 मीटर है। बाग़ का क्षेत्रफल _____ (हेक्टेयर में) है।
solution:
Ratio of sides of the triangle = 12x : 17x : 25x

Perimeter of the triangle = 1080

According to the question

12x + 17x + 25x = 1080

54x = 1080

x = 1080/54 = 20

Side of the triangle are = 12 × 20 = 240, 17 × 20 = 340 and 25 × 20 = 500

S = (240 + 340 + 500) /2 = 1080/2 = 540

Area of the triangle = √[s (s – a) (s – b) (s – c)]

√[540 (540 – 240) (540 – 340) (540 – 500)]

√[540 × 300 × 200 × 40] = 36000 m2

As we know,

10000 m2 = 1 hectares

36000 m2 = 3.6 hectares

question: A dealer allows a 25% discount on the marked price of an article and gains 20%. If the cost price of the article increases by 20%, how much discount percentage should he allow on the marked price so as to earn the same percentage of profit as before?
question_hi: एक व्यापारी एक वस्तु के अंकित मूल्य पर 25% की छूट देता है और 20% लाभ हासिल करता है। यदि वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य 20% तक बढ़ जाता है, तो उसे पहले जितने लाभ का प्रतिशत अर्जित करने के लिए अंकित मूल्य पर कितने प्रतिशत छूट देनी चाहिए?
solution:
Calculation:

Let MP of the article be Rs. 100

SP of the article = 100 × (75/100)

⇒ Rs. 75 

According to the question profit is 20%

⇒ 120% of C.P = 75

⇒ CP of the article = 75 × (100/120)

Again According to the question

New CP = 75 × (100/120) × (120/100)

⇒ Rs. 75

⇒ New SP = 75 × (120/100)

⇒ Rs. 90

Discount percentage = [(100 – 90) /100] × 100

⇒ 10% 

∴ The required discount percent is 10%.

माना वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य 100 रुपये है।

फिर से प्रश्न के अनुसार

⇒ नया क्रय मूल्य = 75 × (100/120) × (120/100)

⇒ 75 रुपए

⇒वस्तु का नया विक्रय मूल्य = 75 × (120/100)

⇒ 90 रुपए

= 10%

question: The average of twelve numbers is 58. The average of the first five numbers is 56 and the average of the next four numbers is 60. The 10<sup>th</sup> number is 4 more than the 11<sup>th</sup> number and the 11<sup>th</sup> number is one less than the 12<sup>th</sup> number. What is the average of the 10<sup>th</sup> and 12<sup>th</sup> numbers?
question_hi: बारह संख्याओं का औसत 58 है। पहली पाँच संख्याओं का औसत 56 है और अगली चार संख्याओं का औसत 60 है। 10वीं संख्या 11वीं संख्या से 4 अधिक है और 11वीं संख्या 12वीं संख्या से एक कम है। 10वीं और 12वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
solution:
Average of 12 numbers = 58

Sum of 12 numbers = 12 × 58 = 696

Average of first 5 numbers = 56

Sum of first 5 numbers = 5 × 56 = 280

Average of next 4 numbers = 60

Sum of next 4 numbers = 4 × 60 = 240

Sum of 10th, 11th and 12th numbers = 696 – 280 – 240 = 176

Let 12th number be x, then

11th number = x – 1

10th number = x + 3

According to the question

x + x – 1 + x + 3 = 176

3x = 176 – 2 = 174

x = 174/3 = 58

12th number = 58

10th number = 58 + 3 = 61

Average of 10th and 12th number = (58 + 61) /2 = 59.5

question: Pipe A can fill a tank of capacity 350 liters in \(3\frac{1}{2}\) minutes. Pipe B can fill a tank of capacity 780 liters in \(8\frac{2}{3}\) minutes. How long (in min) will it take to fill a tank of capacity 1615 liters, if both pipes are opened together?

question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. The tangents to the circle at the points A and C on it, intersect at P. If ∠ABC = 98°, then what is the measure of ∠APC?

solution:
Given, ∠ABC = 98°

As we know,

∠ABC + ∠CDA = 180° [Cyclic quadrilateral]

∠CDA = 180° – 98° = 82°

∠PAC = ∠PCA = ∠ADC = 82° [Alternate segment theorem]

In ΔPAC

∠APC + ∠PAC + ∠PCA = 180°

∠APC + 82° + 82° = 180°

∠APC = 180° – 164° = 16°

Short Trick:

∠APC = 180° - 2 ∠ADC = 180° – 2 × 82° = 16°
solution_hi:
दिया गया है, ∠ABC = 98°

∠ABC + ∠CDA = 180° [चक्रीय चतुर्भुज]

∠CDA = 180° – 98° = 82°

∠APC + 82° + 82° = 180°

∠APC = 180° – 164° = 16°

छोटी विधि:

∠APC = 180° - 2 ∠ADC = 180° – 2 × 82° = 16°

question_hi: एक बर्तन में 5 : 3 के अनुपात में दो द्रवों का एक घोल होता है। जब 10 लीटर घोल को बाहर निकाला जाता है और B की समान मात्रा से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाता है, तो बर्तन में A और B का अनुपात 10 : 11 हो जाता है। बर्तन में घोल की मात्रा (लीटर में), ______ थी।
solution:
Given:

The ratio of the solution of two liquids = 5 ∶ 3

 When 10 liters of the solution is taken out and replaced by the same quantity of B, the ratio of A and B in the vessel becomes 10 ∶ 11.

Detailed Solution: 

Ratio of two liquids A and B is = 5x : 3x

According to the question

\(\frac{{5x - \frac{5}{8} \times 10}}{{3x - \frac{3}{8} \times 10 + 10}} = \frac{{10}}{{11}}\)

⇒ \(\frac{{\frac{{40x - 50}}{8}}}{{\frac{{24x - 30 + 80}}{8}}} = \frac{{10}}{{11}}\)

⇒ (4x – 5)/(24x + 50) = 1/11

⇒ 44x – 55 = 24x + 50

⇒ 44x – 24x = 50 + 55

⇒ 20x = 105

⇒ x = 105/20 = 21/4

Total quantity of liquids = (21/4) × 8 = 42 litres

∴ The quantity of the solution in the vessel was 42 litres.

 

The ratio of two liquids A and B = 5 : 3 or 10 : 6

5 unit = 10 litres

1 unit = 2 litres

10 + 11 = 21 unit = 2 × 21 = 42 litres

∴ The quantity of the solution in the vessel was 42 litres.

दो द्रवों का एक घोल का अनुपात = 5 ∶ 3

जब 10 लीटर घोल को बाहर निकाला जाता है और B की समान मात्रा से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाता है, तो बर्तन में A और B का अनुपात 10 ∶ 11 हो जाता है।

विस्तृत हल:

प्रश्नानुसार

\(\frac{{5x - \frac{5}{8} \times 10}}{{3x - \frac{3}{8} \times 10 + 10}} = \frac{{10}}{{11}}\)

⇒​ \(\frac{{\frac{{40x - 50}}{8}}}{{\frac{{24x - 30 + 80}}{8}}} = \frac{{10}}{{11}}\)

⇒ (4x – 5)/(24x + 50) = 1/11

⇒ 44x – 55 = 24x + 50

⇒ 44x – 24x = 50 + 55

⇒ 20x = 105

⇒ x = 105/20 = 21/4

द्रवों की कुल मात्रा = (21/4) × 8 = 42 लीटर

∴ बर्तन में घोल की मात्रा 42 लीटर थी।

question: An article was sold at a certain price. Had it been sold at 4/5 of that price, there would have been a loss of 10%. At what profit percentage was the article sold initially?
question_hi: एक वस्तु एक निश्चित मूल्य पर बेची गई थी। यदि इसे उस मूल्य के 4/5 पर बेचा जाता, तो 10% की हानि होती। शुरू में वस्तु कितने प्रतिशत लाभ पर बेची गई थी?
solution:
Let SP of the article be Rs. 500x

New SP of the article be = 500x × (4/5) = 400x

CP of the article be = 400x × (100/90) = 4000x/9

Ratio of CP to SP = 4000x/9 : 500x = 40 : 45

Let CP be 40y and SP be 45y.

Profit % = [(45y – 40y) /40y] × 100 = 12.5%
solution_hi:
माना वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य 500x रुपये है।

वस्तु का नया विक्रय मूल्य = 500x × (4/5) = 400x

वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य = 400x × (100/90) = 4000x/9

क्रय मूल्य से विक्रय मूल्य का अनुपात = 4000x/9 : 500x = 40 : 45

माना क्रय मूल्य 40y और विक्रय मूल्य 45y है।

लाभ % = [(45y – 40y) /40y] × 100 = 12.5%

question: The number of families whose monthly expenditures on education are Rs. 2,500 or more but below Rs. 4,000 is what percentage more than the number of families whose monthly expenditures on education are Rs. 4,500 or more but below Rs. 6,000?

Number of families whose monthly expenditures on education are Rs. 4,500 or more but below Rs. 6,000 is = 52 + 43 + 30 = 125

Required percentage = [(172 – 125) /125] × 100 = 37.6%

question: The number 1563241234351 is:
options_hi: न तो 3 से विभाज्य और न ही 11 से
solution:
Divisibility law of 3 ⇒ A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digit is divisible by 3.

Divisibility law of 11: If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because (2 + 4) – (3 + 3) = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

Sum of the digit of the number 1563241234351 is

1 + 5 + 6 + 3 + 2 + 4 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 3 + 5 + 1

= 40

As we know, 40 not divisible by 3 so the number is not divisible by 3.

Now check divisibility rule 11

(5 + 3 + 4 + 2 + 4 + 5) – (1 + 6 + 2 + 1 + 3 + 3 + 1)

23 – 17

6

As we know, 6 is not multiple of 11 so the number is not divisible by 11.
solution_hi:
3 का विभाजन का नियम ⇒ एक संख्या 3 से विभाज्य है यदि उसके अंकों का योग 3 से विभाज्य है।

11 का विभाजन का नियम: यदि संख्या के हर दूसरे अंकों के योग का अंतर 11 का गुणक है (जैसे 2343, 11 से विभाज्य है क्योंकि (2 + 4) - (3 + 3) = 0, जो कि 11 का गुणक है)।

संख्या 1563241234351 के अंकों का योग है

1 + 5 + 6 + 3 + 2 + 4 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 3 + 5 + 1

= 40

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं, 40, 3 से विभाज्य नहीं है इसलिए संख्या 3 से विभाज्य नहीं है।

अब 11 के विभाजन के नियम की जाँच करें

(5 + 3 + 4 + 2 + 4 + 5) – (1 + 6 + 2 + 1 + 3 + 3 + 1)

23 – 17

6

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं, 6, 11 का गुणक नहीं है इसलिए संख्या 11 से विभाज्य नहीं है।

question: The average age of 24 students is 15.5 years. The age of the teacher is 24 years more than the average age of all the students and teacher. What is the age (in years) of the teacher?
question_hi: 24 छात्रों की औसत आयु 15.5 वर्ष है। शिक्षक की आयु सभी छात्रों और शिक्षक की औसत आयु से 24 वर्ष अधिक है। शिक्षक की आयु (वर्षों में) क्या है?
solution:
Short Trick:

Average age of 25 person (24 students + 1 teacher) = 15.5 + 24/24 = 16.5

Age of teacher = 16.5 + 24 = 40.5 years.

Detailed solution:

Let age of teacher be x, then

Average age of 24 students = 15.5 years

According to the question

(15.5 × 24 + x) /25 = x – 24

15.5 × 24 + x = 25x – 24 × 25

25x – x = 24 × 25 + 15.5 × 24

24x = 24 (25 + 15.5)

x = 40.5 years

छोटी विधि:

25 व्यक्तियों की औसत आयु (24 छात्र + 1 शिक्षक) = 15.5 + 24/24 = 16.5

शिक्षक की आयु = 16.5 + 24 = 40.5 वर्ष

विस्तृत हल:

माना शिक्षक की आयु x है, फिर

24 छात्रों की औसत आयु = 15.5 वर्ष

प्रश्नानुसार

(15.5 × 24 + x) /25 = x – 24

15.5 × 24 + x = 25x – 24 × 25

25x – x = 24 × 25 + 15.5 × 24

24x = 24 (25 + 15.5)

x = 40.5 वर्ष

question: The ratio of the volumes of two right circular cylinders A and B is x/y and the ratio of their heights is a : b. What is the ratio of the radii of A and B?

question: The length and breadth of a cuboidal store are in the ratio 2 : 1 and its height is 3.5 metres. If the area of its four walls (including doors) is 210 m<sup>2</sup>, then its volume is ______.
question_hi: एक घनाभाकर गोदाम की लंबाई और चौड़ाई 2 : 1 के अनुपात में है और इसकी ऊंचाई 3.5 मीटर है। यदि इसकी चार दीवारों (दरवाजे सहित) का क्षेत्रफल 210 मी<sup>2</sup> है, तो इसका आयतन ______ है।
solution:
The length and breadth of a cuboidal store ratio = 2x : x

Height of the cuboidal store h = 3.5

According to the question

Area of four wall = 2 (l + b) × h

2 (l + b) × h = 210

2 (2x + x) × 3.5 = 210

3x = 210/7 = 30

x = 30/3 = 10

Volume of cuboidal store = lbh = 2x × x × 3.5 = 2 × 10 × 10 × 3.5 = 700
solution_hi:
एक घनाभाकार गोदाम की लंबाई और चौड़ाई का अनुपात = 2x : x

घनाभाकर गोदाम की ऊँचाई h = 3.5

प्रश्नानुसार

चार दीवारों का क्षेत्रफल = 2 (l + b) × h

2 (l + b) × h = 210

2 (2x + x) × 3.5 = 210

3x = 210/7 = 30

x = 30/3 = 10

घनाभाकर गोदाम का आयतन = lbh = 2x × x × 3.5 = 2 × 10 × 10 × 3.5 = 700

question: The angles of elevation of a pole from two points which are 75 m and 48 m away from its base are α and β, respectively. If α and β are complementary, then the height of the pole is:
question_hi: दो बिंदुओं से एक खंभे के उन्नयन कोण, जो इसके आधार से 75 मीटर और 48 मीटर दूर हैं, क्रमशः α और β हैं। यदि α और β पूरक हैं, तो खंभे की ऊंचाई है:
solution:
Given, BD = 48 and BC = 75

In △ABD

tan β = AB/BD

tan β = AB/48

AB = 48 tan β      ---(1)

In △ABC

tan α = AB/BC

AB = 75 tan α      ---(2)

Multiply by equation (1) from equation (2)

AB2 = 48 × 75 × tan α × tan β

As we know, (α + β = 90), then (tan α tan β = 1)

AB = √(48 × 75)

AB = √(16 × 3 × 3 × 25)

AB = 4 × 3 × 5 = 60 m

SHORT TRICK :

Height of the pole = √(75 × 48) = 60 m

tan β = AB/48

△ABC में

tan α = AB/BC

AB = 75 tan α      ---(2)

AB2 = 48 × 75 × tan α × tan β

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं, (α + β = 90), तो (tan α tan β = 1)

AB = √(48 × 75)

छोटी विधि :

question: The area (in m<sup>2</sup>) of a circular path of uniform width x meters surrounding a circular region of diameter d meters is ______.
question_hi: व्यास d मीटर के एक वृत्ताकार क्षेत्र के चारों ओर एक समान चौड़ाई x मीटर के एक वृत्ताकार पथ का क्षेत्रफल (मी<sup>2</sup>) ______ है।

As we know,

Area of path = π(R2 – r2) = π[(d/2 + x)2 – (d/2)2] = π [d2/4 + x2 + dx – d2/4] = π [x2 + dx]

= πx (x + d)

question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 250. After allowing two successive discounts of 20% and x% on the marked price, it is sold for Rs. 185.60. What is the value of x?
question_hi: एक वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य 250 रुपये है। अंकित मूल्य पर 20% और x% की दो क्रमिक छूट देने के बाद, यह 185.60 रुपये में बेचीं जाती है। x का मूल्य क्या है?
solution:
MP of the article = Rs. 250

SP of the article after getting 20% discount = 250 × 80/100 = 200

Final SP of the article = Rs. 185.60

Discount = 200 – 185.60 = 14.40

Discount % = (14.40/200) × 100 = 7.2%

question: The population of town B is 300% more than that of town A. For the next two years, the population of A increases by x% per year and that of B decreases by the same percentage per year. After 2 years, if the population of A and B becomes equal, then the value of x is ______.

solution:

question: A is twice as efficient as B and C is thrice as efficient as B. Working together, they can finish a certain work in 5 days. A and C worked together for 5 days. B alone would complete the remaining work in ______.
question_hi: A, B से दोगुना कुशल है और C, B से तीन गुना कुशल है। एक साथ काम करने पर, वे 5 दिनों में एक निश्चित कार्य पूरा कर सकते हैं। A और C ने 5 दिनों तक एक साथ काम किया। B अकेले शेष कार्य को ______ में पूरा करेगा।
solution:
Let efficiency of B be 1

Efficiency of A = 2 × 1 = 2

Efficiency of C = 3 × 1 = 3

The ratio of efficiencies of A, B and C = 2 : 1 : 3

Total work = (1 + 2 + 3) × 5 = 30

Work done by A and C in 5 days = (2 + 3) × 5 = 25

Remaining work B will complete in = (30 – 25)/1 = 5 days

शेष कार्य B पूरा करेगा = (30 – 25)/1 = 5 दिन

question: The sum of two numbers is 1215 and their HCF is 81. If the numbers lie between 500 and 700, then the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers is ______.

Number should be between 500 and 700, then

= 5/1512

question: When the radius of a sphere is increased by 5 cm, its surface area increases by 704 cm<sup>2</sup>. The diameter of the original sphere, is ______. (Take π = 22/7)
question_hi: जब किसी गोले की त्रिज्या 5 सेमी बढ़ाई जाती है, तो इसका पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 704 सेमी<sup>2</sup> बढ़ जाता है। मूल गोले का व्यास, ______ है। (π = 22/7 लें)
solution:
Given:

The radius of a sphere is increased by 5 cm

Due to which surface area increased by 704 cm2

Formula Used:

The surface area of sphere = 4πr2

Calculation:

Let radius of sphere be r cm

New radius of sphere = r + 5

As we know,

Surface area of sphere = 4πr2

According to the question

4 π (r + 5)2 – 4 πr2 = 704

⇒ 4 π [(r + 5)2 – r2] = 704

⇒ 4 × (22/7) [r2 + 25 + 10r – r2] = 704

⇒ 25 + 10r = 704 × (7/22) × (1/4)

⇒ 25 + 10r = 56

⇒ 10r = 56 – 25 = 31

⇒ r = 31/10 = 3.1

∴ The diameter of sphere = 2 × 3.1 = 6.2 cm.
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

एक गोले की त्रिज्या में 5 सेमी की वृद्धि की जाती है

जिसके कारण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल में 704 सेमी2 की वृद्धि हुई

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 4πr2

गणना:

माना गोले की त्रिज्या r सेमी है।

गोले की नई त्रिज्या = r + 5

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 4πr2

प्रश्नानुसार

4 π (r + 5)2 – 4 πr2 = 704

⇒ 4 π [(r + 5)2 – r2] = 704

⇒ 4 × (22/7) [r2 + 25 + 10r – r2] = 704

⇒ 25 + 10r = 704 × (7/22) × (1/4)

⇒ 25 + 10r = 56

⇒ 10r = 56 – 25 = 31

⇒ r = 31/10 = 3.1

∴ गोले का व्यास = 2 × 3.1 = 6.2 सेमी
